mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, feature_type, compute_type, data_type, status, business_desc, sql_expr, view_id, view_code, view_field, expr, missing_policy, timeout_ms, ref_count, empty_rate, empty_base, owner, input_count, output_count, input_vars_json, output_vars_json, verify_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM feature WHERE code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%') AND deleted = 0 LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, code, name, feature_type, compute_type, data_type, status, business_desc, sql_expr, view_id, view_code, view_field, expr, missing_policy, timeout_ms, ref_count, empty_rate, empty_base, owner, input_count, output_count, input_vars_json, output_vars_json, verify_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM feature WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, code, name, feature_type, compute_type, data_type, status, business_desc, sql_expr, view_id, view_code, view_field, expr, missing_policy, timeout_ms, ref_count, empty_rate, empty_base, owner, input_count, output_count, input_vars_json, output_vars_json, verify_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM feature WHERE code = #{code} AND (deleted = 0 OR status = 'OFFLINE') ORDER BY (deleted = 0) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, code, name, feature_type, compute_type, data_type, status, business_desc, sql_expr, view_id, view_code, view_field, expr, missing_policy, timeout_ms, ref_count, empty_rate, empty_base, owner, input_count, output_count, input_vars_json, output_vars_json, verify_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM feature WHERE feature_type = 'BASE' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT verify_status AS verifyStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM feature WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY verify_status
mapper.update: UPDATE feature SET status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE feature SET deleted = id, status = 'OFFLINE' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
